extraction: Raw VizieR asu-tsv response saved verbatim. Rows counted after skipping '#' comment lines, the header line, the units line and the '---' separator line; blank trailing lines excluded.
note: Simard et al. 2011 ApJS 196, 11, Table 3: PURE SERSIC GIM2D decompositions of SDSS DR7 galaxies, retrieved as a CONE SEARCH of radius 110 arcmin centred on Abell 2029 at RA=227.7337 Dec=+5.7444 (radius chosen to enclose the full ~100 arcmin extent of the Sohn+2019 member list). This is a FIELD catalogue, not a member catalogue: it contains all SDSS DR7 spectroscopic-sample galaxies in the cone regardless of cluster membership. Use the derived join file A2029_members_Sohn2019_x_Simard2011_structural.csv to select actual members. MEASURED (2D GIM2D single-Sersic fits to SDSS g and r imaging): ng = Sersic index with error e_ng; e = ellipticity with error (axis ratio q = 1 - e); phi = position angle in deg with error; gg2d/rg2d = pure-Sersic model g and r AB magnitudes with errors (-> g-r colour); gg2df/rg2df fibre magnitudes; dCol delta fibre colour; S2g/S2r image smoothness; z = SDSS redshift (spectroscopic where Sp is not -1). SEMI-MODEL-DERIVED: Rhlg/Rhlr (semi-major-axis half-light radius) and Rchl_g/Rchl_r (circularised half-light radius) are in kpc, converted from the measured angular size using the redshift and an assumed cosmology; Scale is the kpc/arcsec factor; ggMag/rgMag are absolute rest-frame magnitudes (cosmology- and k-correction-dependent); Vmax is a volume correction. CAVEAT: ground-based SDSS imaging at roughly 1.4 arcsec seeing. These structural parameters are much coarser than the HST-based Granata+2026 fits used for the HFF clusters and are limited to r < 17.77, the SDSS spectroscopic limit.
